coverageNotes: Tests native default order and cursor continuation by prediction; API production, custom timestamp sorting and frontend integration remain unconverted.

questions.question: Which title sequence is returned across the three pages?

options.text: [A, B], then [C, D], then [E]; the third page has isDone: true.
options.rationale: Incorrect: the default creation-time ordering is reversed by order("desc").

options.text: [A, C], then [E, D], then [B]; the third page has isDone: true.
options.rationale: Incorrect: createdAt is an ordinary application field and does not determine the default query order.

options.text: [E, D], then [C, B], then [A]; the third page has isDone: true.
options.rationale: Correct: default order is by system creation time, and each native cursor continues after the preceding page.

options.text: [E, D], then [E, D], then [E, D]; the third page has isDone: false.
options.rationale: Incorrect: the supplied continueCursor advances the native query; it does not restart at its newest row.
